description: A custom Android view class 'FeatureImage' that displays either a drawable image or a geometric pattern of triangles with color variations, including animation effects. It is used to render feature images with fallback patterns based on color if no image is provided.

classes.name: FeatureImage
classes.description: A custom ImageView that displays a drawable or a geometric pattern of triangles with color variations, with animation capabilities.

methods.name: setColour
methods.description: Sets the triangle colors based on a given color, creating two variations and assigning them randomly to triangles.

methods.name: setColorAndAnimateChange
methods.description: Sets the color and triggers an animated transition.

methods.name: animateColourChange
methods.description: Animates the alpha transparency of the pattern for visual transition.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Calculates and creates triangle paths based on view size, arranging them in a pattern.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the drawable image if available; otherwise, draws the triangle pattern with color variations.

methods.name: createTriangle
methods.description: Creates a triangle Path given three points, ensuring clockwise point order.

methods.name: loadImageAndDisplay
methods.description: Loads an app's feature graphic or icon and displays it, falling back to pattern if needed.

methods.name: loadImageAndExtractColour
methods.description: Loads an image and attempts to extract a color, falling back to a gray color on failure.
